title: S15 api-gateway — API surface
description: Port 7750, prefix API-. External-facing REST gateway: authenticates every non-local request by calling S12 POST /verify, authorizes the route against the token's read/write scopes, then reverse-proxies /portfolio/** to S9 and /settlement/** to S14 (path rewritten by stripping the gateway prefix, query forwarded, upstream status+body passed through verbatim). Local endpoints (served by the gateway itself, no auth): GET /healthz, /readyz, /routes, /stats. Every non-local route requires an 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header; a 404/405 is answered before auth. Upstream errors pass through verbatim (e.g. a 409 STL-205); the gateway adds its own API- envelope only for transport/auth failures. Errors: API-201 missing token (401), API-202 token rejected (401), API-203 forbidden/scope (403), API-204 bad body (400), API-404 no route (404), API-405 method not allowed (405), API-502 proxy upstream (502), API-503 auth upstream (503, retryable).

authorizationHeader.description: Required on every non-local route. Value must be 'Bearer <token>' (case-insensitive scheme). Missing/malformed => API-201 (401) without contacting S12.

portfolioRoutes.description: GET routes proxied to S9 portfolio-analytics (read scope). Path is rewritten by stripping the /portfolio prefix.

settlementRoutes.description: Routes proxied to S14 settlement-service. Writes (settle/finalize/ingest) require the write scope; reads require the read scope.

routesResponse.description: GET /routes — the static route table (11 entries). Each entry describes one proxy route; 'path' is the wildcard form /<prefix>/**.

readyz.description: GET /readyz — the common {status, reasons}; readyz probes S12 GET /healthz only (a dead S9/S14 affects individual proxied requests, not gateway readiness).

missingTokenError.description: 401 — the standard §1.2 envelope for a missing/malformed Authorization header (API-201).

tokenRejectedError.description: 401 — S12 returned a 4xx; API-202 with context.detail = '<S12-code>: <reason>' (code only when S12 gave no reason).

forbiddenError.description: 403 — the token is valid but lacks the route's required scope (API-203); context carries the required_scope.

noRouteError.description: 404 — no route owns the path (API-404); answered before auth. context = {method, path}.

methodNotAllowedError.description: 405 — the path's route does not allow the method (API-405); answered before auth. context = {method, path, allowed:[...]}.
